arts.ttl: Monaco’s confidence low ahead of PSG clash in French league
arts.sum: Monaco has a squad packed with talent but already lags 10 points behind PSG, having lost five of its 13 league matches. Still unbeaten at home, second-place Marseille hosts Toulouse as it seeks to extend its winning streak to four matches in all competitions.
